intent: Preserve authored arithmetic and parameter expressions while solving ordinary point and circle lengths in SI before geometry or analytic intersection planning.
steps: Add the three named length parameters through DesignPatch. Create sketch:new_1 owned by feature:sketch_new_1 on existing feature:datum with current identity/revision.
Review/apply primitives through plan_sketch_edit/apply_sketch_edit. Inspect solved centre (2,-3) mm, radius 10 mm and unchanged authored arithmetic strings.

Extrude a 6 mm NewBody feature:disc_body of profile:circle:ent:disc. Review/apply parameter_radius. The authored radius changes while physical radius remains 10 mm; Undo/Redo must retain both exact source forms.

Read-only plan_curve_edit of ent:guide with cutter ent:disc, mode trim, end end, new_point_id ent:cut_end, intersection_index 1 yields (10,3) mm; index 0 yields (-6,3) mm. Omitting the branch refuses.
Reject angle/unknown units, unknown or angle-named length parameters and division by zero. Preserve source, history and publication on refusal.
Grade exact source expressions/dependencies and fresh native SI STL, not the reported volume alone.
compatibility: ADR-108; existing expression grammar and geometry. Literal Coord numbers remain SI. Constraints drive seeds as before. No new UI control, schema or score.
